shots.test: plain text offers Paste, Paste as file, Upload and paste link, and Pin
formatted text also offers Paste as plain text
text with spaces or blank lines around it also offers Paste trimmed
Base64 of a readable text also offers Paste decoded Base64
a text with %-codes also offers Paste URL-decoded
an image offers Paste, Paste as file, Upload and paste link, and Pin
a file offers Paste, Paste as compressed file and Pin
several files offer the same as one file
other data offers only Paste and Pin
text with links also offers the link actions
